description: T6-4 (docs/test-campaigns/phase-12.md): the watch executor gets four workers. Expected to SURVIVE: _watch_loop awaits each rebuild before pulling the next change, so only one rebuild is ever submitted at a time and the worker count cannot matter. This records that the await alone serializes rebuilds. If this spec starts reporting 'killed', the await has been lost and max_workers=1 is now the only thing keeping rebuilds apart.
